7444638.baseName: Argos Home 6ft Curved Top Slim Christmas Tree
7444638.variantName: Argos Home 6ft Curved Top Slim Christmas Tree
7444638.sourceDescription: There's something quietly cheerful about a Christmas tree that fits just right without crowding the room. This one has a playfully curved top that gonk fans will spot straight away. It's slim enough to tuck into tight corners or smaller spaces, so you can bring festive cheer home even when square footage is tight. The hinged branches fluff out quickly when you're ready to set it up, then you can layer on your own lights, baubles and decorations however you like. The flat needles create a fuller shape, and it comes with a metal stand to keep everything steady. It's made from PVC and designed for indoor use. The design handles plenty of lights if you want sparkle, and once the season's over, it packs away without fuss. You can bring it back out next year and do it all over again. . 8267560.sourceDescription: Bring the festive magic without taking up the whole room. This parasol Christmas tree starts halfway up the wall, keeping your decorations safely out of reach from little hands and curious pets while leaving plenty of floor space underneath for presents. It's made from PVC with hinged branches that drop neatly into place once you've slotted the pieces together, then you just give them a quick fluff to bring them to life. The generous number of tips delivers that full festive look without needing a huge footprint. The metal stand keeps everything stable and secure, and when the season wraps up, the whole thing packs back into its box ready to bring the cheer year after year. It's designed for indoor use so you can style it however you like, and there's plenty of room to add lights and decorations to make it your own. . wvh21cwc.baseName: Ark Mat 58cm Artificial Wreath - Frosted Evergreen
wvh21cwc.variantName: Ark Mat 58cm Artificial Wreath - Frosted Evergreen
wvh21cwc.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
